stem: Which of the following best explains why cells that contain the same genetic material do not develop into the same types of cells?

options.label: A
options.text: Because internal or external stimuli can trigger the activation of specific genes in the DNA of cells

options.label: B
options.text: Because random mutations can occur in the DNA of cells during early embryonic development

options.label: C
options.text: Because messenger RNA is converted to transfer RNA when cell differentiation begins

options.label: D
options.text: Because chemical signals that are released during the cell cycle can result in the linking of similar genes

visual_elements: Diagram showing Totipotent Stem Cells, Pluripotent Stem Cells, and Specialized Stem Cells developing into Specialized Cells with descriptions for each cell type.
